cases.title: Fade Out
cases.author: Ivan & Claude
cases.blurb: Hollywood, 1946. Movie star Rex Calloway is found shot in his convertible below the Hollywoodland Sign, his famous face gone. His wife identified him in under a minute. The studio wants it called an accident.

cases.title: The Last Encore
cases.author: Ivan & Claude
cases.blurb: A trumpet player is found dead in his hotel room next to an empty bottle of sleeping pills. The coroner says sleeping pills don't do that. A short case that shows every part of the system.
